column1: # H. pylori methylation motifs from the SMRT methylomes of Krebes et al. 2014 (NAR, PMC3936762), Tables 1-2: the
# independent ground truth for the 26695 and J99 rows (replaces the Dorado-derived differential sets and the REBASE
# presets that were unmethylated in the samples). offset = 0-based index of the modified base in the motif as written
# 5'->3'; for a modified base on the complementary strand the offset points at the top-strand base it pairs with
# (spec_positions 'both' handles the orientation). pct = % of motif sites detected methylated by SMRT. Frameshift-repair
# specificities (inactive in the wild type) are left out; GCGC (m5C, ~50% methylated) is listed but excluded from truth.
